description: This is a SQL migration script that manages database schema changes for user authentication. It drops legacy tables and types, creates a unified users table and a pending signups table, and sets up triggers, indexes, and policies related to user authentication flows such as email verification and password resets.

methods.name: public.set_updated_at
methods.description: A trigger function that automatically updates the 'updated_at' timestamp on row modifications in the 'users' and 'pending_signups' tables.
